proposals.before: On renyin day in the second month Li Jizhong, supreme army commander of the fourth banner, was granted honorary Sikong and Grand Pillar of State.
proposals.after: On renyin day in the second month Li Jizhong, supreme army commander of the fourth banner, was granted honorary Situ and Grand Pillar of State.
proposals.reason: Chinese 檢校司徒 is honorary Situ (司徒), not Sikong (司空).

proposals.before: In the second month, on renyin day, Fourth Banner supreme army commander Li Jizhong was made honorary Sikong and Grand Pillar of State.
proposals.after: In the second month, on renyin day, Fourth Banner supreme army commander Li Jizhong was made honorary Situ and Grand Pillar of State.
proposals.reason: Chinese 檢校司徒 is Situ, not Sikong.

proposals.before: On bingzi day in the seventh autumn month Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen sent attendants Nielidi and Gan Qinge to report the recovery of Shuozhou and the capture of Song general Yang Jiye and to present the seals, cords, patents, and orders taken by the Emperor; Nielidi and the others received wine and silver vessels.
proposals.after: On bingzi day in the seventh autumn month Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen sent attendants Nielidi and Gan Qinge to report the recovery of Shuozhou and the capture of Song general Yang Jiye, and to submit the captured officers’ seals, cords, patents, and orders; Nielidi and the others received wine and silver vessels.
proposals.reason: 上所獲 means submitted what was captured; 上 is the verb “submit,” not “the Emperor.”

proposals.before: On the bingchen new moon of the tenth winter month the Tangut and Zubu sent envoys with tribute.
proposals.after: On the bingshen new moon of the tenth winter month the Tangut and Zubu sent envoys with tribute.
proposals.reason: Chinese 丙申朔 is bingshen, not bingchen (丙辰).

proposals.before: In winter, tenth month, on the bingchen new moon, the Tangut and Zubu sent envoys with tribute.
proposals.after: In winter, tenth month, on the bingshen new moon, the Tangut and Zubu sent envoys with tribute.
proposals.reason: Chinese 丙申朔 is bingshen, not bingchen.

proposals.before: On gengwu day Chief Councillor Han Derang was promoted to Grand Preceptor.
proposals.after: On gengwu day Chief Councillor Han Derang was appointed acting Situ.
proposals.reason: Chinese 守司徒 is Situ, not Grand Preceptor (太師/太保).

proposals.before: On gengwu day Chief Councillor Han Derang was promoted to Grand Preceptor.
proposals.after: On gengwu day Chief Councillor Han Derang was appointed acting Situ.
proposals.reason: Chinese 守司徒 is Situ, not Grand Preceptor.

proposals.before: An edict ordered Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan, yuyue Molugu, and Grand Preceptor Lin Ba to hold the frontier firm and let no spies slip through.
proposals.after: An edict ordered Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan, yulin Molugu, and Grand Preceptor Lin Ba to hold the frontier firm and let no spies slip through.
proposals.reason: Chinese 林牙謀魯姑 is yulin, not yuyue (於越).

decisions.reason: s0009 has 檢校司徒; 司徒 is Situ, not Sikong (司空), so honorary Situ is the accurate repair.
The literal likewise misreads 檢校司徒 as Sikong; replacing with Situ matches the Chinese office title.
In 及上所獲將校印綬、誥敕, 上 is the verb submit and 所獲將校印綬 are the captured officers' seals; the Emperor did not take them.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 及上所獲將校印綬、誥敕

decisions.reason: s0142 reads 丙申朔; 丙申 is bingshen, whereas bingchen would be 丙辰.
The literal has the same sexagenary error; bingshen correctly renders 丙申.
s0161 has 守司徒; that is acting Situ, not Grand Preceptor (太師/太保).
The literal repeats the Grand Preceptor misreading; acting Situ correctly renders 守司徒.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以政事令韓德讓守司徒

decisions.after: An edict ordered Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan, yulin Molugu, and Grand Commandant Lin Ba to hold the frontier firm and let no spies slip through.
decisions.reason: 林牙 is yulin, not yuyue, but 太尉林八 is Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor (太師); the proposal left that title wrong.
